##### Project general facts

Elite DownTown Residence is a newly launched residential project in the emerging district, designed with sumptuous and stylish fully furnished residences. Standing tall with a striking presence, this development features a collection of studios and one, two, and three-bedroom freehold apartments, emphasizing larger living spaces to provide high-quality living. With swimming pool, gym, and children's play area at the podium level, every element is crafted to offer residents a lifestyle of comfort and sophistication in the centre of now.

Elite DownTown Residence flaunts gorgeous fully furnished apartments with a range of premium amenities designed to enhance daily living. The podium level features a swimming pool, a fully equipped gym, and a dedicated children's play area, ensuring relaxation, fitness, and family-friendly spaces are always within reach. Every detail is curated to provide a seamless blend of luxury and convenience.

Every residence at Elite DownTown Residence features luxury finishes and is fully furnished, offering a turnkey living experience. Kitchens are fully equipped with appliances included, ensuring effortless everyday living. The interiors are designed with sumptuous style, creating spaces that are both elegant and functional, where residents can enjoy the pinnacle of contemporary living.

##### Location description and benefits 

Nestled within the Burj Khalifa Community in Downtown Dubai, this exceptional location is at the centre of a range of shopping, leisure, and recreational outlets. Home to many landmarks and world-famous attractions including Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall, and the Dancing Fountains, the area is a hub of activities that keeps Downtown busy throughout the year.

The location is distinguished by its effortless mobility, with Burj Khalifa and Business Bay Metro stations within close reach and easy access to major transport routes including Sheikh Zayed Road, Financial Centre Road, and Al Khail Road. Downtown is well connected to other key commercial and residential areas in the city, making it one of Dubai's best areas for non-drivers and frequent travellers.

For those seeking a residence that embodies luxury, convenience, and a prime Dubai address, Downtown Dubai delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of world-class attractions, strategic connectivity, and a prestigious location makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one is only minutes away from everything Dubai has to offer.
